newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar closes softer on technical factors.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar closes softer on technical factors.

text.p: The Canadian dollar weakened in trading driven by technical indicators Thursday, to close at C$1.3360 (US$0.7485) from Wednesday's close at C$1.3337 (US$0.7498), dealers said.
The currency strengthened during early trading on cross buying against the mark and then weakened later in cross trading against the Australian dollar, dealers said.
When the currency hit C$1.3370, a key technical point, investors began buying Canada again to pull the currency back to C$1.3360 at the close, they said.
A stronger bond market also helped firm the currency.
